description: Source code for the class 'ModifySubjectResponse' which represents the response to a 'ModifySubject' command within a policies modification context in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It handles creation, parsing, and serialization of responses related to subject modifications, including metadata like policy ID, label, subject ID, and created subject details.

classes.name: ModifySubjectResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a ModifySubject command, including methods for creating, parsing from JSON, and accessing response data such as policy ID, label, subject ID, and created subject.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a new response indicating a subject was created, with policy ID, label, created subject, and headers.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a new response indicating a subject was modified, with policy ID, label, optional subject ID, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object into a ModifySubjectResponse instance.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the policy ID associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry related to this response.

methods.name: getSubjectCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Subject if available.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the created subject as a JsonValue, if available.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Builds and returns a JsonPointer to the resource related to this response, based on subject ID.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes fields like policy ID, label, subject ID, and subject created into a JsonObjectBuilder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response with updated DittoHeaders.
